name: Certificate / PFX bundle
description: Match a certificate to a private key and create a PKCS#12/PFX bundle.

web.input_label: private key, CAPI/CNG key, or a folder of them
web.workflow_help: Drop one PEM/DER private key, one encrypted CAPI/CNG key, or a whole folder of keys. For encrypted CAPI/CNG keys, also add their DPAPI masterkey material in 2. Unlock key. Tab 1 is not used.
web.help: Recovers each key (a ready PEM/DER key, including password-protected PEM/DER, or a CAPI/CNG key decrypted with 2. Unlock key material) and matches it to a certificate by public key. Drop one certificate or a folder (for example a copied SystemCertificates\My\Certificates directory). Each match is reported by the certificate SHA1 thumbprint and bundled into its own PFX.

fields.name: certificate
fields.label: matching certificate or certs folder
fields.help: PEM, DER, or serialized Windows certificate; a single file or a dropped folder of certificates.

fields.name: key_password
fields.label: Private-key password
fields.help: For password-protected PEM/DER key input; one value is applied to the supplied key or key folder.

fields.name: pfx_password
fields.label: New PFX password
fields.help: Password that will protect the generated PFX.

fields.name: empty_pfx_password
fields.label: Create unencrypted PFX
fields.help: Use only when an intentionally unencrypted PFX is required.

fields.name: pfx_password_file
fields.label: PFX password file
fields.help: Alternative to entering the new PFX password above.
